english.title: Fail to ensure pig vaccinated against classical swine fever is identified in accordance with instructions
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a keeper who had

(A)_[a pig]_
(B)_[pigs]_

vaccinated against classical swine fever

(C)_[in an emergency vaccination zone,]_
(D)_[under the authority of a licence granted by a veterinary inspector,]_
(E)_[in an emergency vaccination zone under the authority of a licence granted by a veterinary inspector,]_

failed to ensure that

(F)_[it was]_
(G)_[they were]_

identified in accordance with instructions from a veterinary inspector
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations regulations 30(2)(a) and 39(1)(k) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence no longer applies after 28th April 2026, due to changes made by the Exotic Animal Disease (Amendment) (England) Order 2026 (SI 2026/475). For the offences of failing to ensure pig vaccinated against classical swine fever are identified in accordance with instructions (Wales) and failing to ensure pigs vaccinated against classical or African swine fever are identified according to instructions (Eng) after this date, see H102730 and H102731.

other.penalty:
Either waySummary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
